asymmetry_declared: state_1 (CONTROLLED_NULL) is a POSITIVE finding about the INSTRUMENT and state_2 (STRUCTURE_PRESENT) is NOT a finding about mathematics. Neither outcome supports any GOAL-ENDO-001 hypothesis. A `p > 0.05` result means NO STRUCTURE DETECTED AT 200 REPLICATES, never 'no structure exists': the resolution floor is 1/201 = 0.004975 and the design's power against a small effect is not characterised.
denominator_used_by_the_decision_rule: THE COUNT, over the full 144-cell frame. The frozen statistic is a COUNT and the null is drawn over the same 144-cell frame, so the denominator does not enter the p-value at all. 50 reproduces under BOTH denominators because the six-cell difference is cells with no defined R at any rung, which cannot be in the residue under either. Both fractions are reported.
evidence_strength_cap: Any evidence record arising from this control is capped at `preliminary` and `claim_tier: toy` regardless of outcome. Under AGENTS.md rule 12 the contradiction between a validated execution report and an independent review already requires further independent review before ANY evidence record is written from this line of work.
frozen_decision_rule_statistic: Two-sided empirical p-value of the observed type-A residue count in the shuffled null, computed as (1 + #{replicates at least as extreme}) / (1 + n_replicates), extremeness measured as |x - median(null)|.
